# Phase Two — Gevurah: 24 Critiques

The Awtsmoos gives light while Gevurah shapes the vessel true; Awtsmoos.com must reject seductive shortcuts that would fracture what we do.

1. Do not attempt true WebGPU, full NLE, collaboration server and cloud render farm before the canonical domain is stable.
2. Do not create another movie core; all new contracts live under `apps/shared/movie`.
3. Do not silently delete the older adapter paths while they are untracked and potentially consumed.
4. Do not couple core movie objects to DOM, Canvas, Three.js or app-specific classes.
5. Keep seconds as canonical time and translate native milliseconds at app boundaries.
6. Require protocol/version on every canonical movie.
7. Preserve unknown future fields through normalization/migration where possible.
8. Make validation error codes stable enough for UI and AI repair loops.
9. Never accept a layer whose local end exceeds its scene.
10. Never accept a keyframe outside the layer-local duration.
11. Validate references to cast/assets/parents.
12. Make patch operations target stable IDs and reject stale/missing targets explicitly.
13. Patches need inverse information or snapshots so undo is real.
14. AI provider abstraction must work with no provider and must not pretend fallback parsing is model reasoning.
15. Adapters must share one result contract and never silently flatten.
16. Mobile controls need practical touch targets and responsive layout, not merely `@media` cosmetic shrinking.
17. Canvas proof renderer should remain deterministic and low-dependency rather than pretending to be full 3D.
18. True 3D belongs behind an interface so Animator can supply the spatial engine.
19. Asset hashes/provenance must not require network access to validate ordinary projects.
20. Tests should exercise observable contracts rather than implementation internals.
21. The 180-second proof must include visible timeline diversity rather than repeating one generated template.
22. Runtime proof requires measured media or frame output, not metadata claims.
23. Every touched existing file needs collision hash verification immediately before rewrite.
24. Completion requires a final delta pass; success in one renderer does not close cross-app obligations.
